basics.name: Myrtle Elizabeth Warren
basics.label: Ghost, Lavatory Specialist & Plumbing Systems Consultant
basics.phone: Available via echo-shout through Chamber of Secrets plumbing system
basics.summary: Experienced post-mortem presence with over eight decades of uninterrupted occupancy of the Hogwarts girls' second-floor lavatory. Specialist knowledge of the Hogwarts castle plumbing infrastructure, subsurface pipe network, and the operational layout of the Chamber of Secrets entrance system. Witnessed and can provide detailed first-hand testimony on key events of the Second Wizarding War including the reopening of the Chamber of Secrets, the Polyjuice Potion brewing incident, and early Horcrux creation theory development. Self-described 'emotional intuition specialist.' Seeking consulting, historical witnessing, or hauntings (residential or commercial welcome).

location.address: Second Floor Girls' Lavatory, East Corridor

work.name: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry — Second Floor Girls' Lavatory
work.summary: Perpetual resident presence within the second-floor girls' east lavatory, overseeing the cubicles, pipe network, mirrors, and surrounding plumbing infrastructure. Provides unsolicited emotional commentary, student welfare monitoring, and occasional operational disruption. Has existed in this role continuously for over eighty years with no planned departure.
highlights: Maintained continuous unbroken occupancy of the lavatory for over 80 years — a record for single-location haunting by a Hogwarts ghost that remains unchallenged
Managed lavatory access across an estimated 10,000 student-visits per academic year, developing an extensive knowledge of student behaviour patterns, confidential conversations, and personal habits

Successfully flooded the lavatory on 47 documented occasions in response to perceived emotional distress, interpersonal conflicts, or moderate inconvenience — demonstrating advanced control of the cold water system via pipe-phase transit
Facilitated Hermione Granger's brewing of a successful Polyjuice Potion by permitting the use of the out-of-service lavatory as a secure preparation environment during the 1992–93 academic year
Provided Harry Potter with the critical clue to the location of the Triwizard Tournament's second task egg solution, enabling him to complete the task and survive
Served as the only eyewitness to the original opening of the Chamber of Secrets in 1943 — testimony provided to Albus Dumbledore in 1992 and subsequently to Ministry of Magic investigators
Demonstrated phase-transit capability through the full castle plumbing system, covering a documented range of two complete floors and the Chamber of Secrets sub-basement

Has resisted all formal attempts by Hogwarts administration to relocate or exorcise her presence, successfully arguing legal protections under the Ghosts and Sentient Post-Mortem Presences Act of 1694

work.name: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry
work.summary: Retained by Professor Albus Dumbledore to provide formal witness testimony on the events of June 1943 relating to the opening of the Chamber of Secrets and the death of Myrtle Warren. Testimony was instrumental in establishing the identity of the original perpetrator and the nature of Voldemort's diary Horcrux.
highlights: Provided the only direct eyewitness account of the 1943 opening of the Chamber of Secrets — testimony retained in Dumbledore's personal Pensieve archive
Identified Tom Marvolo Riddle as the student responsible for her death based on memory of the yellow eyes she observed in her final moments
Testimony contributed to the successful identification, retrieval, and destruction of Riddle's diary as a Horcrux in 1993
Willingly submitted to multiple memory extraction sessions despite the emotional distress of reliving the incident, with minimal collateral wailing

work.name: Self-Employed
work.position: Freelance Crier, Moper & Emotional Disruption Consultant
work.summary: Provides on-demand emotional disruption services, extended wailing performances, and passive-aggressive lavatory hauntings throughout the Hogwarts school term and holiday periods. Also available for deep personal wallowing sessions if the client needs someone to truly understand their suffering.
highlights: Disrupted Professor Umbridge's Educational Decree enforcement operations on three separate occasions by flooding the lavatory precisely as inspections were scheduled

Provided unsolicited but surprisingly accurate emotional counselling to Draco Malfoy during the 1996–97 academic year, demonstrating an instinct for identifying genuine distress beneath defensive behaviours
Has reduced forty-seven students to tears (net neutral: she was already crying when they arrived), creating a peer-support dynamic that she considers professionally meaningful
Maintains the most detailed informal surveillance record of student lavatory-based confidential discussions in Hogwarts institutional history

volunteer.summary: Participates in the annual Ghost Council meetings as a non-voting associate, following a protracted dispute over her territorial jurisdiction claims that extended from 1943 to 1949.
highlights: Proposed the 1967 amendment to the Ghost Territorial Compact clarifying that lavatories constitute independent jurisdictions not subject to corridor-based senior ghost precedence

Submitted fourteen formal grievances to the Council between 1943 and 2024, of which three were upheld in full, seven were upheld in part, and four were classified as 'emotionally complex and deferred'

references.name: Hermione Granger, Senior Auror Liaison & Brightest Witch of Her Age
references.reference: Myrtle was — and I am choosing my words carefully — indispensable on several occasions. She allowed us to use the bathroom for the Polyjuice Potion without asking a single question, which was actually quite considerate in hindsight, even if she did spend the entire period making the process very emotionally taxing. Her knowledge of the plumbing layout was also crucial. I would not have survived the Chamber of Secrets incident without the information she provided. That is on the record.

references.name: Harry Potter, Head Auror — Ministry of Magic
references.reference: Myrtle told me to put my egg in the water and listen to it. That's all I'll say. I owe her a significant portion of my continued existence and I try to honour that by not pointing out that she stared at me in my prefect bath for approximately forty minutes.

references.name: Nearly Headless Nick (Sir Nicholas de Mimsy-Porpington), Gryffindor House Ghost
references.reference: Myrtle is a singular presence. Singular in the sense that there is no other ghost like her and also singular in the sense that she is, topographically speaking, in her bathroom alone at all times. She has an architectural knowledge of the lower castle that surpasses even my own — I once asked her about a drainage anomaly in the east wing and received a two-hour lecture that was, against all odds, actually correct. She is difficult. She is also, in the specific ways that matter, reliable.

projects.name: The Great Corridor Flood of 1961
projects.description: A single-session flood operation that saturated the second-floor east corridor and extended into three adjacent classrooms — the most geographically extensive flooding event in Hogwarts ghost history. Triggered by a dispute over Hallowe'en feast seating allocation. Duration: 2 hours and 17 minutes uninterrupted.
highlights: Covered an area of approximately 340 square feet of castle corridor with an average water depth of three inches
Disrupted three simultaneously-in-session classes, causing them to relocate to the fourth floor
Prompted the first formal Ghost Territorial Compact amendment in forty years
Remains the benchmark event referenced in all subsequent Hogwarts flood incident protocols

projects.name: Chamber of Secrets Testimony and Investigation Support (1992–93)
projects.description: Provided ongoing intelligence support and eyewitness testimony during the Chamber of Secrets investigation, including first-hand account of the 1943 attack, lavatory access facilitation for Polyjuice Potion production, and intelligence on student movements within the school.
highlights: Sole surviving witness to the 1943 attack — testimony provided the critical identification linking Tom Riddle to the Chamber
Permitted Hermione Granger's use of the lavatory as a covert Polyjuice laboratory over a two-month period without formal disclosure
Identified the S-bend trap entrance to the Chamber of Secrets to Harry Potter and Ron Weasley, enabling their descent
Agreed to serve as Harry Potter's emergency contact point in the event of his non-return from the Chamber — maintained a vigil of above-average sobriety for the duration of the mission
